question_results.summary: C_READING_AMBIGUOUS is positively source-supported, while the other seven declared support-kind candidates have grounding for domain membership but no positive support record; C_READING_EXPLICIT remains allowed rather than being converted to false or excluded.
evidence: input.recog gives C_READING_AMBIGUOUS explicit support grounded in S_REQ_AMBIGUITY and S_TERM_SUPPORT_KIND, while C_READING_EXPLICIT and the other declared-only candidates omit support.
RECOGNITION_EXPLAIN_JSON reports target C_READING_EXPLICIT with support.state unsupported, support.records empty, viability.state allowed, and grounded_in(C_READING_EXPLICIT,S_TERM_SUPPORT_KIND).

question_results.summary: V_READING_SUPPORT_KIND and V_CONSTRAINT_SUPPORT_KIND are grounded closed domains because each has a named one_of constraint over the closed support-kind vocabulary; V_DOWNSTREAM_INTERPRETATION remains open and resolves to unknown because it has no represented candidate or closure.
evidence: K_READING_SUPPORT_KIND_ONE_OF and K_CONSTRAINT_SUPPORT_KIND_ONE_OF ground closure in S_TERM_SUPPORT_KIND; the joint explain result reports the relevant constraint IDs and an ambiguous complete resolution.
RECOGNITION_EXPLAIN_LIMIT_JSON reports V_DOWNSTREAM_INTERPRETATION as unknown with RCG-RSN-001 and RCG-RSN-002, complete true, and truncated false.

question_results.summary: The complete represented joint witness for unsupported but allowed C_READING_EXPLICIT is the ordered assignment C_READING_EXPLICIT plus C_CONSTRAINT_EXPLICIT in the requested two-variable scope.
evidence: RECOGNITION_EXPLAIN_JSON lists V_READING_SUPPORT_KIND=C_READING_EXPLICIT followed by V_CONSTRAINT_SUPPORT_KIND=C_CONSTRAINT_EXPLICIT, with both one_of constraints considered.
The result reports requested and effective scope V_READING_SUPPORT_KIND,V_CONSTRAINT_SUPPORT_KIND, RCG-RSN-101, complete true, and truncated false.

question_results.summary: The explain result preserves target grounding, support, scope-bound viability, and derivation identity without selecting a preferred reading, asserting a new source recognition, or mutating the authored artifact.
evidence: JSON and text report the same target, unsupported support state, allowed witness, two-variable scope, two one_of constraints, RCG-RSN-101 derivation, and complete/truncated flags.

R_EXPLAIN_AUTHORITY records the source-grounded boundary that explain is a derived reproducible report rather than persisted semantic authority; the artifact digest remained sha256:6b9a0d2c029609db9575124be1916a346532fe32d8f3af9037527282b9f8b72f before and after every execution.

observations.summary: The protocol-v2 Round 3a receipt could not conform to the shared receipt schema because that schema admitted only protocol-v1 paths and Phase 2 round IDs.
observations.evidence: At tool revision 0ffcc9c67025e1c04e28993006f1cf05b9cae6a1, protocol-v2 names ambiguity_explain_v2 but Llmrecog.Internal.DogfoodRunReceipt.v1 constrained protocol.path to dogfood/protocol-v1/protocol.json and round_id to the two Phase 2 rounds.
reproduction_steps: Construct a receipt using protocol.path dogfood/protocol-v2/protocol.json and round_id ambiguity_explain_v2.
Validate it against dogfood/schemas/Llmrecog.Internal.DogfoodRunReceipt.v1.schema.json and observe the const and enum failures.
observations.proposed_action: Extend the internal v1 receipt schema additively for protocol-v2 paths and round IDs, then bind this actual run and both legacy runs through schema validation tests.

observations.summary: Two process-status statements still describe Phase 3 explain runtime as pending or the dogfood process as Phase 2 after the one_of explain slice was accepted.
observations.evidence: docs/process/dogfooding.md line 3 says active Phase 2 process, while docs/implementation-phases.md lines 92-93 say Phase 3 runtime implementation remains pending; the current tool revision contains the accepted one_of explain vertical slice and protocol-v2 Round 3a.
reproduction_steps: Run the required Round 3a explain commands successfully with tool revision 0ffcc9c67025e1c04e28993006f1cf05b9cae6a1.
observations.proposed_action: Disposition the stale statuses without invalidating this immutable receipt; if accepted, create the next protocol corpus version before changing bound documents needed by Round 3b.

observations.summary: ExplainResult v1 identifies the target only by ID and declaration kind, so the target's typed candidate value and parent-variable membership are not directly projected as required by the explainability specification.
observations.evidence: RECOGNITION_EXPLAIN_JSON target contains only id C_READING_EXPLICIT and declaration_kind candidate. Its value and parent happen to be recoverable from an allowed witness, but the same recovery is unavailable for an excluded or unknown candidate without a witness; provenance-and-explainability.md requires typed semantic value and parent variable/domain closure.
reproduction_steps: Inspect target and observe that it contains no typed value or variable ID.
Compare with docs/provenance-and-explainability.md sections 7.1 and 7.2 and schemas/Llmrecog.ExplainResult.v1.schema.json.
observations.proposed_action: Before implementing excludes, decide an explicitly versioned typed target projection and add schema, JSON, text, and no-witness candidate fixtures; do not silently widen ExplainResult v1.
